caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame sketched with pencil, positioned centrally on an off-white background. Within the framed area, there is a detailed depiction of a metallic object that resembles a ring or a compact case, rendered mostly in shades of grey with subtle highlights. At the center of this object, there is an embossed image of two figures embracing. The majority of the interior background within the frame is lightly shaded with greenish-blue pencil, and there is a darker, horizontal greenish-blue band situated near the bottom of the frame. The top and bottom edges of the rectangular frame are also sketched with pencil lines. The surrounding border area of the paper is left uncolored, maintaining the natural cream tone of the paper.
title: Silver Snuff Box
